# Makinda

Makinda follows Obsidian's appearance setting, switching between light and dark modes automatically. Its recorded description states that the CSS palette is generated from a central source so colors stay consistent across both modes.

![Makinda screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/makindajack/makinda-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Makinda"
    author: "makindajack"
    repo:   "makindajack/makinda-obsidian"
    slug:   "makinda"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/makinda"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/makindajack/makinda-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/makindajack/makinda-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Makinda to auto-switch between light and dark modes with Obsidian’s appearance setting. Keep a single, consistent CSS palette generated from a central source for cohesive colors across modes."
}
```
